source_review_conclusion: No concrete source blocker after the physical Edit route correction; ready to integrate and repin, then exact-source full CI/fresh rendered review.
observations: No concrete source blocker remains in the reviewed URL test draft. The change is insertion-only in one GUI test file: all 107 baseline macro spans and every original file line remain bytewise/in order across the same five tests.

The physical route is narrowly 960 × 800, scale 1, on the freshly opened unscrolled routing page. Add at (400,339) and Edit at (767,339) are separated from the File buttons in the historical source-identical frame. Previously empty child slots and exact visible chooser contents establish admission; a wrong hit fails rather than falling back or retrying input.

The initial Edit draft canceled its physical chooser; Add and Edit have identical choices in that state, so cancellation did not independently prove the route. Root corrected this before source review completion: the physical child stays live, the preserved duplicate callback is blocked, pointer identity is checked, and the unchanged event7 replacement assertion distinguishes Edit from append.

Complete chooser titles, ordered labels and common description match recorded chooser 0–3, including the explicit single-choice cases and allow_insta_one_item_select=false. This checks native behavior against the reference recording; the flag itself is reference metadata rather than a native widget property.

Real retained adapters advance timers/rendering for at least 35 ms, require inactive animations and consecutive identical buffers, and fail at two seconds. Captures require a visible actual owner; no child flags, animation state or caption are forced.

Full saved Routing plus typed Manager equality is checked before staging, after Cancel and after Apply. The expected persisted URL key/name and PNG routing are compared completely, and reopened URL/File labels and unselected URL rows match the staged state. Existing washing, MIME, consumer and other-child assertions remain but receive no additional leaf credit.

Both Add and Edit retire a genuinely pending chooser through parent Cancel and compare a current successor against complete visible draft cells, selection/flags, full saved Routing/Manager, labels and current slot identities/visibility. Edit now stages two rows and positively replaces the second while preserving the first; Add positively appends. Temporary child/parent hide refuses chosen without taking the slot, then re-show permits current acceptance. Parent Cancel discards the successor draft.

The helper uses short-lived RefCell reads, existing generated Slint APIs, explicit pointer events and a full Store read closure compatible with current APIs. Source inspection found no immediate ownership, borrow, Rust API or strict-lint blocker; compilation is not inferred from this review.
finite_limits: Only URL Add/Edit are reviewed here. The companion Add Defaults test is separate and has not been reviewed by this packet. No MIME/nested File/default route/launch/parent/alias completion credit follows.

URL ownership coverage is limited to the tested parent Cancel/replacement and child/parent hide/re-show cases. Automatic Main destruction, final Bound drop, arbitrary page switching and broader ownership guarantees remain outside scope.

The existing Qt PNG shows a later renamed/missing/wrong-type state, not native event7 or the new choosers/notice. It supports outer-control context, not matched chooser pixels, placement, dialog decoration or framework typography.

Six new defining frames and the existing routing context still require fresh exact-source full Linux CI and actual independent visual inspection. Supported 520 × 440 choices, 520 × 200 Information and 960 × 800 parent views do not establish universal/default-size geometry.
